analysis.title: [GS] Added third hike, Is the AI investment cycle durable?, Chinese profits
key_insights: GS adds a third 25bp Fed rate hike to its forecast for March 2027. It still expects a second 25bp hike in December. The October CPI report surprised meaningfully to the upside across several categories and was the third month of worse inflation news.

GS thinks March is slightly more likely than January for the third hike. It expects softer November and December inflation reports, then larger start-of-year price increases that lift January inflation.

GS says the inflation news was not entirely one-sided. Oil futures have fallen substantially since the elections, so the bulk of the energy-shock passthrough to consumer prices should be behind us. It remains confident inflation will be meaningfully lower by the end of 2027 as tariff, energy and AI price pressures fade.

GS suspects most FOMC participants will signal a third hike in the December dot plot. A firmer January inflation report would make delivering the hike the path of least resistance even if the energy shock appears over by then.

GS leaves its terminal fed funds forecast unchanged at 3.25-3.5%. Rate cuts now begin one quarter later, in December 2027 instead of September 2027, followed by cuts in March, June and September 2028.

Top of Mind podcast on AI investment durability: recent AI-related market stresses and new regulatory uncertainty are raising questions about the cycle. Guests are Chamath Palihapitiya, GS's Eric Sheridan and Miriam Wheeler and other GS credit and equity analysts. Topics are the source of the stress, who holds the risk in the AI ecosystem, and where the ROI outlook stands.

China Strategy clusters 6,000+ listed Chinese companies across 47 industries into 5 growth buckets. GS projects 10% trend EPS growth and 12% normalized ROE over 5 years, pointing to 10-15% index re-rating upside from current levels. The Growth universe has shifted and become narrower.

China positioning by bucket: build core holdings around structural growth themes such as AI and Going Global. Stay bullish on Stable and Cash Return Growth. Re-engage profit turnaround and free cash flow names in De-rated and Cyclical Growth. Avoid Depressed Growth until property prices stabilize, possibly in 2028/2029.

China Batteries after the Battery Corporate Day and 3Q26 results: managements expect strong near-term production into 4Q and 2027 demand growth of 20-30% for power batteries and over 30% for energy storage systems.

China batteries margins: consumption tax pass-through is largely in place for energy storage. Passenger vehicle negotiations continue, with full resolution expected by 1Q27, which supports tier-2 battery maker margins next year. Copper foil and separators are seeing pricing expansion on tight supply, while lithium materials face unit profit headwinds from lower lithium prices. GS highlights Buy-rated Zenergy.

Fujikura: Q2 operating profit of ¥130.2bn beat GS estimates on generative AI data center demand. Full-year operating profit guidance was trimmed slightly to ¥429bn from ¥432bn on forex headwinds and lower expected second-half telecom profitability. The annual dividend forecast was raised to ¥80 from ¥42. GS cut its 12m target price to ¥5,000 from ¥7,600 but stays Buy.
GS also cites a Core PCE estimate of 0.35% for October following the above-expectation core CPI print.
Rating changes listed: Pluxee upgraded to Neutral, Kurita Water downgraded to Neutral from Buy, Daikin Industries upgraded to Buy from Neutral, Kuehne & Nagel cut to Neutral.

market_movers.rationale: Fujikura 12m target price cut to ¥5,000 from ¥7,600 but shares appear undervalued. Q2 operating profit of ¥130.2bn beat GS estimates on generative AI data center demand.
Zenergy is highlighted as an underappreciated high-growth battery platform with improving competitive positioning and a favorable growth-return balance.
Daikin Industries upgraded to Buy from Neutral on strong profit delivery and an execution outlook set to be recognized.
Kurita Water Industries downgraded to Neutral from Buy after reviewing the applied multiple on uncertainty over electronics profit improvement.
Kuehne & Nagel cut to Neutral on reduced relative upside potential.
Pluxee upgraded to Neutral after underperformance.

tension_points.bull_case: Oil futures have fallen substantially since the elections, so most of the energy-shock passthrough is behind us. GS expects softer November and December inflation reports and meaningfully lower inflation by the end of 2027 as tariff, energy and AI price pressures diminish.
tension_points.bear_case: October CPI surprised to the upside across several categories, the third month of worse inflation news. GS expects larger start-of-year price increases to boost January inflation and most FOMC participants to signal a third hike in the December dot plot.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Softer-than-expected inflation in the November and December reports would favor the later or smaller hike path. A firmer January inflation report would make delivering the third hike the path of least resistance.
